Emergency fund balance after interest

Source: R/ef_growth.R
ef_growth.Rd

Grows a balance at an annual percentage yield (APY) for a number of months. From the Emergency fund chapter.

Usage

ef_growth(balance, apy, months)

Arguments

balance

Starting balance.

apy

Annual percentage yield, as a decimal.

months

Number of months.

Value

A numeric vector of balances.

See also

Other emergency fund: emergency_fund_target(), monthly_contribution_needed(), months_to_ef_goal()

Examples

# $9,600 at 4% APY for 12 months
ef_growth(balance = 9600, apy = 0.04, months = 12)
#> [1] 9984
